tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers the forecast horizon and has useful gradient variation, so the main uncertainty is whether the five endpoint measurements can separate the coupled transient parameters. The trajectory batch adds time-resolved observations to constrain the memory dynamics before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five terminal observations at similar horizons leave no residual degrees of freedom and may not distinguish memory coupling from fast relaxation.
Not offered, and the pilot already spans s_grad from 0.25 to 2.2 without a narrow-gradient warning.
It does not resolve the transient parameter ambiguity.
